_comment: Reviewed list of Mac-only menu/control labels that are never a Lulo gap: OS chrome, iCloud-only features, and services Lulo has deliberately not promised. `app` is "*" for every app or a Lulo app display name. `match` is "exact" (default) or "prefix". Add rows here only after a human confirms the item is genuinely out of scope, with a reason a reviewer can check.

entries.label: Apple
entries.reason: The system Apple menu is OS chrome (About This Mac, System Settings…, Sleep/Restart/Shut Down, Recent Items, App Store updates), not part of any app's own menu bar. Lulo's shell has no per-app equivalent slot for it.

entries.label: Services
entries.reason: Services is populated system-wide from every installed app's Info.plist; Lulo has no Services architecture and nothing to port.

entries.label: Recent Items
entries.reason: AppKit's own Recent Items submenu under the Apple menu (the app's own File > Open Recent is tracked separately and is NOT allowlisted).

entries.label: Start Dictation…
entries.reason: Apple dictation (on-device/cloud speech-to-text) is an Apple Intelligence/Siri feature with no Linux equivalent shipped yet.

entries.label: Emoji & Symbols
entries.reason: The macOS character viewer is a system input-method feature, not an app menu command; Lulo has its own emoji picker reachable another way (tracked separately in docs/parity.md, not here).

entries.label: Share…
entries.reason: macOS Share sheets hand off to iCloud/AirDrop/Mail/Messages/social extensions. Lulo has no share-sheet architecture; this is a standing, intentionally-deferred gap tracked as a whole in docs/parity.md rather than per occurrence here.

entries.label: Add to Dock
entries.reason: macOS-specific Dock integration for files, distinct from Lulo's own Dock (which already pins apps); porting "add a file alias to the Dock" is not planned.

entries.label: Make Alias
entries.reason: Classic Mac OS aliases (resolved by Finder/the OS at open time) have no Linux filesystem equivalent; Lulo would need symlinks instead, tracked as a design question in docs/parity.md, not a straight menu-item port.

entries.label: Compress using Keka
entries.reason: Injected by the Keka Finder Sync extension installed on the reference Mac, not by stock Finder. Any third-party Finder extension's rows are machine-specific and never a Lulo gap; re-check this list if the reference Mac's installed extensions change.

entries.label: Extract using Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: Send to Keka
entries.reason: See "Compress using Keka": the Keka Finder Sync extension, not stock Finder.

entries.label: AirDrop & Handoff
entries.reason: AirDrop and Handoff require Apple devices and Continuity services.

entries.label: Apple Account
entries.reason: Apple Account is an Apple identity service.

entries.label: Apple Intelligence & Siri
entries.reason: Apple Intelligence and Siri require Apple services and models.

entries.label: AppleCare & Warranty
entries.reason: AppleCare warranty lookup applies only to Apple hardware.

entries.label: Family
entries.reason: Family Sharing is an Apple Account service.

entries.label: Game Center
entries.reason: Game Center requires Apple game services.

entries.label: iCloud
entries.reason: iCloud requires Apple Account cloud services.

entries.label: Screen Time
entries.reason: Apple Screen Time sync and parental controls depend on Apple services.

entries.label: Wallet & Apple Pay
entries.reason: Wallet and Apple Pay require Apple payment services and hardware.

entries.label: <Owner>, Apple Account
entries.reason: The reference Mac owner’s Apple Account card requires Apple Account services.

entries.label: AutoFill
entries.reason: macOS AutoFill reads the Apple Contacts, Passwords, and Wallet stores.

entries.label: Contact…
entries.reason: This AutoFill source is the Apple Contacts store.

entries.label: Passwords…
entries.reason: This AutoFill source is the Apple Passwords store.

entries.label: Credit Card…
entries.reason: This AutoFill source is the Apple Wallet card store.

entries.label: macOS Help
entries.reason: This opens Apple’s macOS Help documentation.

entries.label: macOS Support
entries.reason: This opens Apple’s macOS support site.

entries.label: MacBook Air Specifications
entries.reason: This opens specifications for the reference Mac’s Apple hardware.

entries.label: Hardware Support
entries.reason: This opens Apple hardware support for the reference Mac.

entries.label: User Manual
entries.reason: This opens the Apple macOS user manual.

entries.label: Device Management
entries.reason: This pane manages Apple MDM profiles; Lulo has no Apple MDM enrollment.
